name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST With TWO Prior Apprenticeships (Three Rows)
description: Approves two different prior apprenticeships (standards 30 and 31) for the same learner/provider, both completing in AY 25/26, then POSTs a third, new draft apprenticeship (standard 21). Each approval goes through the classic AddLearningCommandHandler path (ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent), which inserts its own row into ApprenticeshipLearning — so by the time the draft POST lands, the learner has TWO ApprenticeshipLearning rows, for different courses to the new one. CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle now calls GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode) — course-scoped, returning a list — instead of the old unconditional GetByLearnerKey().SingleOrDefaultAsync() that used to throw InvalidOperationException the moment a learner had more than one ApprenticeshipLearning row. Since neither prior row matches the new draft's course, SelectExistingLearningToUpdate finds no candidate and a fresh third row is created. Expect a 202 on the final POST (the outer API's async-accepted response) and three ApprenticeshipLearning rows for the learner.

steps.name: Commitments Approves Prior Apprenticeship #1, Standard 30, Ending 2026-03-31 (AY 25/26)
SLD Records Completion on Prior Apprenticeship #1
Commitments Approves Prior Apprenticeship #2, Standard 31, Ending 2026-06-30 (AY 25/26)
SLD Records Completion on Prior Apprenticeship #2
SLD Create a New Draft Apprenticeship, Standard 21, Same Learner/Provider

assertions.name: Draft POST succeeds (no .Single() crash with 2 prior rows)
Learner now has three ApprenticeshipLearning rows
